phase_name: Cockpit Conformance Promotion (R13-R18 binding + cockpit-html + monitor surfaces)
goal: Promote v3.3 band-grammar from advisory to binding by adding R13-R18 to design-rules.json, wiring checkR13..checkR18 in conformance-check.cjs, registering cockpit-html + monitor surfaces, and locking the contract behind 4 SAC tests.

decisions.decision: After codex-executor.sh (Windows shell-exec block) + codex-patch-executor.sh (review-skill conflict) both returned empty patches, orchestrator authored SAC-P134-01..04 directly. Established pattern from SAC-P128-01, P129-05, P126-01, P132-05, R16 fail-safe.

SAC-P134-03 uses a synthetic HTML fixture (5 stages + 3 bands + 1 northstar) rather than renderHtml(fixture). renderShell carries band markers; client.js injects stage cells at SSE-render time. Synthetic fixture proves the surface wiring without coupling the gate to client.js, which has its own SAC-P132-* gates.

consumers: v3.3 P135 (visual polish — already closed PASS-WITH-DEFERRED)
constraints: Any new cockpit-html surface output must satisfy R13 (exactly 1 northstar/recommended-action loud-line), R14 (5 stage cells), R15 (Band 3 subheads when visible), R17 (ELI5 lint ≤5 out-of-list words), R18 (3 data-band placeholders)
Any monitor PS surface output must satisfy R17
JSON snapshots emitting alerts must satisfy R16 (palette_tier on every alert)
extension_points: v3.4 can add R19+ for new IA section coverage as it lands
